text:
alex: FYI, canary deploy of kernel-picker rolled at 2026-03-17 15:02 - noticed p50 jumps on Mixtral-8k chat templates.

maria: confirmed in grafana — p50 42ms -> 52ms on host pool 'mix-1', token throughput stable but CPU sched up. :thinking:

cheng: profiler shows extra branch in kernel selection hitting byte-fallback path when tokenizer emits 2 extra special tokens (chat header + role). looks like KV coalescing logic causes re-warm of KV cache per segment.

alex: attaching quick trace:
```
CPU: kernel_picker.cpp:line 178 choose_kernel_for_heads()
stack: choose -> coalesce_kv -> fallback_kernels::byte_path
metrics: alloc_peak +20%, p50 +10%
```

lisa: can you paste the prompt example that triggers it? I suspect chat templates with leading \n and special BOS cause tokenizer to produce BOM-like byte fallback on some Mixtral tokenizers.

alex: example (sanitized):
```
"[SYSTEM]\nYou are Redwood.\n" + user_prompt
```
results in tokens: [BOS, 0xEF,0xBB,0xBF, 'You', ...] on old byte tokenizer variant.

cheng: workaround: force tokenizer normalizer (normalize_output: true) or strip leading whitespace. Patch candidate in PR #3456.

maria: also saw KV cache miss rate spike from 2%->9% during same window — coalescing was splitting KV entries when byte fallback switched encoding mid-sequence.

devops: rolled back canary at 15:25, p50 returned to baseline. keeping canary paused.

alex: next steps: add unit test for tokenization edge cases, update kernel-picker to prefer stable kernel when tokenizer variant differs, and add metric for 'byte_fallback_invocations'.

infra-bot: Created issue I-2026: 'kernel-picker: regression with byte-fallback + KV coalescing' and linked PR #3456. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll own monitor dashboards and add an alert on byte_fallback_invocations > 0.5% per minute.

lisa: thanks. if you need a quick hotfix, we can gate kernel-picker for Mixtral until tokenizer patch lands.

alex: agreed. +cc @product for heads-up.
